questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage an emergency: a patient fainted in the waiting room. The assistant is the first to intervene. What is her role?
options: Wait for the dentist to arrive
Call emergency services and perform first aid if trained
Take the patient out of the practice
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'An assistant trained in first aid can save lives while waiting for emergency services to arrive.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage a postoperative stress situation with an anxious patient. The assistant can play a role. What is her role?
options: Let the dentist handle it alone
Reassure the patient and explain postoperative instructions
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'The assistant can play a key role in reassuring and informing the anxious patient.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a stockout of critical consumables. The assistant is responsible for stock management. What is the best practice?
options: Wait for the stockout to order
Set up a minimum stock system with regular orders
Order in bulk once a year
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'A minimum stock system helps avoid stockouts and ensures continuity of care.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must handle a patient complaint about reception. The assistant is on the front line. What is the right attitude?
options: Listen actively and propose a solution
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Active listening and proposing solutions turn a complaint into a loyalty opportunity.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must organize the management of computerized patient files. The assistant has a key role. What is her responsibility?
options: Data entry, updating and securing patient files
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The assistant is responsible for data entry, updating and securing patient files.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage a patient with a disability. The assistant can facilitate access. What is the best approach?
options: Treat the patient like everyone else
Adapt the welcome and support to specific needs
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Adapting the welcome and support ensures quality care for all patients.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a conflict between a patient and the dentist. The assistant can play a mediation role. What is the right attitude?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Neutrality and facilitating communication help defuse the conflict.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must organize his assistant's training in new technologies. What is the best method?
options: Organize practical training sessions with a trainer
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Practical training sessions ensure quick and effective mastery of new technologies.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a confidentiality situation: a patient asks for information about another patient. The assistant should:
options: Refuse and remind the confidentiality rules
Give the information if the patient insists
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Respecting confidentiality is a fundamental principle. The assistant must refuse any request for information about another patient.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate the quality of reception in his practice. The assistant is on the front line. Which indicator is most relevant?
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'The patient satisfaction rate is the most relevant indicator of reception quality.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must organize appointment management. The assistant is responsible. What is the best practice to optimize appointments?
options: Use scheduling software with automatic reminders
Let patients choose their own schedules
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Scheduling software with automatic reminders helps optimize appointments and reduce no-shows.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage a workplace stress situation. The assistant is affected. What is the best approach?
options: Organize relaxation moments and team bonding activities
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Relaxation moments and team bonding strengthen resilience to stress.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must train his assistant in telephone call management. What is the good practice?
options: Answer only at the end of the day
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Professional telephone reception enhances the practice's image and patient satisfaction.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage a telework situation for his assistant. What is the best approach?
options: Set up communication and monitoring tools
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Telework requires communication and monitoring tools to guarantee efficiency.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a moral harassment situation in his team. The assistant is affected. What is the priority?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Protecting the victim is the absolute priority in cases of moral harassment.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate his assistant's digital skills. Which tools should she master?
options: Management software, communication tools and tele-transmission platforms
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'The modern assistant must master management software, communication tools and tele-transmission platforms.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a discrimination situation in his team. The assistant is a victim. What is the right approach?
options: Sanction the discriminatory behavior and protect the victim
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Discrimination is a serious fault. Discriminatory behavior must be sanctioned and the victim protected.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must organize continuing education for his assistant. What is the recommended frequency?
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Regular continuing education allows the assistant to stay up to date and develop her skills.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a crisis situation (work accident). The assistant is injured. What is the priority?
options: Treat the assistant and report the accident
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The assistant's health is the priority. The accident must be reported according to procedure.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate the quality of his assistant's work. What criteria should be considered?
options: Quality of assisted care, rigor and patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Quality of assisted care, rigor and patient relationship are the most important criteria.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage an assistant who has absenteeism problems. What is the right approach?
options: Identify the causes and offer support
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Identifying the causes and offering support help resolve absenteeism problems.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must organize office supply management. The assistant is responsible. What is the good practice?
options: Establish a supply list and order regularly
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'A supply list and regular orders help optimize stock management.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage an assistant who has difficulties with new technologies. What is the best solution?
options: Offer her training adapted to her pace
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Adapted training allows the assistant to progress at her own pace and gain confidence.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki, after training an exceptional team, receives congratulations from Dr Chiba. What is the next step for Dr Zaki?
options: Create a mentoring program for new assistants
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Creating a mentoring program allows passing on knowledge and training the new generation.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba and Dr Zaki, after years of collaboration, have formed an exceptional team. What message do they wish to convey to young practitioners?
options: The assistant is an indispensable pillar of the practice
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba and Dr Zaki conclude: 'The assistant is an indispensable pillar of the practice, on par with the dentist.'
